what was ash ketchum's second pokemon?: Ash Ketchum catches Caterpie in the first episodes of the Pokémon anime, right after receiving Pikachu. It later evolves into Butterfree, which he lets go in a famous emotional scene.
who is the true moon princess in sailor: Usagi Tsukino is Sailor Moon, who is revealed to be the reincarnation of Princess Serenity of the Moon Kingdom. Other Sailor Guardians protect her.
which one piece character is able to spr: Nico Robin ate the Hana Hana no Mi (Flower-Flower Fruit), which lets her sprout copies of her limbs on any surface. The only thing that blocks her is sea prism stone, the mineral that weakens all Devil Fruit users.
what is the source of the saiyans power: Saiyans, a warrior race in Dragon Ball Z, use ki, the life energy inside every living thing, and their power rises dramatically when they recover from near-death injuries. This is why they get stronger after hard fights.
in the dragon ball z series, saiyans los: A Saiyan's tail is a weak point: if it is grabbed or cut, they lose strength. Many Saiyans, including Goku, train to overcome this weakness, and a Saiyan's tail can be removed.
how old is naruto in the 2nd part of the: In Naruto Shippuden, the second part of the series, Naruto is 15, after a two-and-a-half-year time skip. In Part I he was only 12.
what kind of magic does gray fullbuster: Gray Fullbuster uses Ice-Make magic, which allows him to create objects and weapons from ice. It's one of the most-used magic types in Fairy Tail.
what pokemon species is kakuna?: Kakuna is a Bug/Poison-type Pokémon, known as the Cocoon Pokémon. It evolves from Weedle and eventually becomes Beedrill.
what type of pokemon is fearow?: Fearow is a Normal/Flying-type Pokémon, the Beak Pokémon, and the evolved form of Spearow. Its long beak and strong flight make it a speedy attacker.
raticate evolves from rattata and is thi: Raticate is the evolved form of Rattata and is a Normal-type Pokémon. Its sharp front teeth never stop growing, so it gnaws constantly.
arbok is a vengeful pokemon creature of: Arbok, the Cobra Pokémon, is a Poison-type, and it evolves from Ekans. The pattern on its belly is said to scare enemies.
what type of pokemon is the aggressive a: Mankey, the Pig Monkey Pokémon, is a Fighting-type known for flying into fits of rage. It evolves into Primeape.
what type of pokemon is graveler?: Graveler is a dual Rock/Ground-type Pokémon, the evolution of Geodude. It evolves into Golem when traded in the early games.
this 1988 anime feature, set in tokyo, i: Akira (1988), directed by Katsuhiro Otomo, is set in Neo-Tokyo in 2019, where biker Tetsuo gains psychic powers from a government experiment. It helped introduce anime to Western audiences.
who is the colossal titan in \"attack on: Bertholdt Hoover is the Colossal Titan in Attack on Titan, and he is one of the Titan shifters who broke through Wall Maria. His name is also romanized as "Bertolt".
what's the english dub name of \"smile p: Smile Precure! was adapted into English as Glitter Force, released on Netflix in 2015. It is part of the long-running Pretty Cure magical-girl franchise.
the two main characters of \"no game no: Sora and Shiro, the genius siblings of No Game No Life, play online games together as a team called "Blank". They never lose.
what is gatomon's name in the original j: Gatomon is called Tailmon in the Japanese version of Digimon Adventure. She is a cat-like Digimon who is Kari's partner.
in \"the melancholy of haruhi suzumiya\": In The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya, Haruhi has the power to change reality without knowing it, so the other SOS Brigade members treat her like a god. She doesn't realize it.
in the 2012 animated film \"wolf childre: Ame and Yuki are the wolf children in the 2012 film Wolf Children, directed by Mamoru Hosoda. Their mother raises them in the countryside after their father, a wolf man, dies.
in the fairy tail anime and manga series: Wendy Marvell is a Sky Dragon Slayer, trained by the dragon Grandeeney, and she uses wind magic to heal and boost allies. She is the youngest of the main Dragon Slayers in Fairy Tail.
which one of these manga titles was not: Naoki Urasawa created Monster, 20th Century Boys and Pluto, among many others. "My Father's Journal" is not by him but by another manga artist, Jiro Taniguchi.
which of the following manga have the mo: Golgo 13, a manga about an assassin that started in 1968, has more than 200 volumes, which makes it among the longest-running manga series. Tankōbon means the collected volume editions.
in \"a certain magical index,\" what is: Accelerator, from A Certain Magical Index, can control vectors, meaning he can redirect any force, motion or energy that touches him. That makes him the strongest esper in Academy City.
in \"jojo's bizarre adventure: stardust: Jotaro Kujo, protagonist of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stardust Crusaders, wields the Stand Star Platinum. The series is known for naming Stands after music and bands.
which of the stands from \"jojo's bizarr: Pearl Jam is a Stand from JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 4 and is named after the rock band. Many JoJo Stands are named after musicians and songs.
what is the name of the protagonist of t: Phosphophyllite, called Phos, is the protagonist of Land of the Lustrous (2017), a gem person who wants to be useful. The characters are living gems.
which of the following anime of the mech: The Super Dimension Fortress Macross began airing in 1982, and it was famous for its transforming Valkyrie fighters and for mixing mecha action with pop music. It later became part of the Robotech series in the West.
which one piece character is the carpent: Franky, a cyborg shipwright, joins the Straw Hat Pirates after building their ship, the Thousand Sunny. He runs on cola.
goku, the main character of the dragon b: Goku has two sons, Gohan and Goten. Gohan is the eldest and Goten is the youngest.
this character from sailor moon, whose t: Sailor Neptune, Michiru Kaioh, carries the Deep Aqua Mirror, and she first appears in Sailor Moon S with her partner Sailor Uranus, Haruka Tenoh. They are among the Outer Senshi.
in the fairy tail anime and manga series: Exceeds are winged cat-like creatures from Edolas in Fairy Tail. Happy and Carla are the best known.
in \"future diary\", what is the name of: In Future Diary, Yuno Gasai's diary is called the "Yukiteru Diary" because it records everything about Yukiteru Amano. Her obsession with him is the heart of the series.
what is the name of jojo's bizarre adven: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 5 is Vento Aureo ("Golden Wind"), set in Italy and following Giorno Giovanna. It's a story about gangsters and Stands.
who is the main heroine of the anime, fu: Kaname Chidori is the main heroine of Full Metal Panic!, a high school student whom the mercenary Sousuke Sagara is assigned to guard. She has a secret that makes her a target.
the name of junko enoshima's imposter at: Mukuro Ikusaba pretends to be Junko Enoshima early on in Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc. Junko's twin sister Mukuro is a soldier, and the reveal is a major twist.
what anime studio was in charge of the h: Made in Abyss (2017) was animated by Kinema Citrus. The story follows a girl, Riko, who descends into a huge pit full of dangerous creatures.
in the adv (english) dub of the anime \": Ghost Stories is known for its English dub, which replaced the original horror script with crude jokes and pop culture references. The dub became a cult classic because it is so over the top.
which anime did seiji kishi not direct?: Seiji Kishi directed anime such as Angel Beats! and Durarara!!, but not Another. That 2012 horror series was directed by Tsutomu Mizushima.
in \"hunter x hunter\", which of the fol: Hunter x Hunter's six Nen types are Enhancement, Transmutation, Emission, Conjuration, Manipulation and Specialization. Restoration isn't one of them.
which animation studio animated \"psycho: Psycho-Pass, a 2012 sci-fi crime series set in a surveillance state, was made by Production I.G. The studio is also known for Ghost in the Shell.
which of these anime have over 7,500 epi: Sazae-san, running since 1969, is the longest-running animated TV series in the world, with well over 7,000 episodes. It airs weekly in Japan.
in the first episode of yu-gi-oh: duel m: Thus Spoke Zarathustra is a philosophical novel by Friedrich Nietzsche, published in the 1880s, which introduced ideas about the "Übermensch" or superman. It fits the cold, ambitious Kaiba.
who is the mother of fictional character: Kushina Uzumaki is Naruto's mother and the wife of the Fourth Hokage, Minato Namikaze. She was the previous host of the Nine-Tailed Fox.
in the rurouni kenshin anime series, whi: Kenshin Himura uses the Hiten Mitsurugi-ryu sword style in Rurouni Kenshin, which relies on speed and powerful strikes. He fights Udō Jin-e in the Kyoto arc.
who is the master of fairy tail in the s: Makarov Dreyar is the third master of the Fairy Tail guild, and he is a powerful Wizard Saint known for being short in stature. Gildarts is another strong member.
